title: Query Optimization — Companion Code
description: Runnable PostgreSQL for the query-optimization recipe: a seeded demo schema, EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) exercises covering Seq Scan vs Index Scan, covering indexes, N+1 vs JOIN, OFFSET vs keyset pagination and NOT IN vs NOT EXISTS, plus pg_stat_statements monitoring queries.
description_es: PostgreSQL ejecutable para la receta de optimización de consultas: esquema de demo con datos, ejercicios de EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) que comparan Seq Scan vs Index Scan, índices covering, N+1 vs JOIN, paginación OFFSET vs keyset y NOT IN vs NOT EXISTS, más consultas de monitoreo con pg_stat_statements.
